metadata.documentTitle: (9+) Today, on Father's Day, I'm thinking about how my dad immigrated to the United States after escaping three civil wars and working as a janitor, only to see his bloodline die out because his son stumbled into a menswear forum and then spent the next 20 years arguing about pants with teenagers named Pablo Thriftscobar.

textContainers.innerTextRaw: I lol so much over these stories from children of immigrants bringing ridicule to their hardworking ancestors, but also...YEA, this is why they came here. So you have the chance to argue with Pablo Thriftscobar about pants - and bring a lot of joy to people while doing it. (I say this a child of an immigrant raised in refugee camps, as I sit here wasting the potential my grandparents worked so hard for)
